name: towers-match
note: towers_auto: two bots hold map 1 for 2400 ticks: they hop their cursors across their own shares, build, upgrade and call a wave, and the creeps come down the path on the crowd. Everything named is simulation, so every host agrees on it. The control is one frame short.

name: towers-build
note: towers, one player on a pad: start, choose map 1, then the build diamond: north builds a bolt on the first pad, a hop right, west a frost, a hop down, east a beam, and a shoulder calls the first wave early.
